operations.details: Verified Ordnance Survey historic datum-height guidance.
Historic vertical datum differences rejected as one universal constant.
Geographic variation from historic levelling retained as reference context.
No historic datum offset applied blindly to parcel LiDAR values.
Verified OS legacy passive-station search guidance.
Legacy passive network separated from current OS Net active infrastructure.
Passive-station coordinate uncertainty not promoted to parcel-result accuracy.
No-longer-maintained legacy control rejected as current observation evidence.
Current OS Net/OSTN15/OSGM15 lineage remains required.
No legacy station or datum value substituted for parcel elevation.
Canonical manifest unchanged; serial publisher still required.
